title: Analysis of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) in biochar treated stormwater
author: Celma, Dahlberg, et al.

steps.title: Vacuum filter stormwater
steps.instruction: Filter the biochar‑treated stormwater through a glass microfiber disk filter (Whatman GF/C, 47 mm) under vacuum to remove suspended solid particles.

steps.title: Spike filtrate with internal standards
steps.instruction: Collect a 40 mL aliquot of the filtrate and spike it with the mixture of isotopically labelled internal standards (ILIS) to serve as surrogates for PAHs and derivatives.

steps.title: Load sample onto SPE cartridge
steps.instruction: Pass the spiked 40 mL sample through an Oasis HLB SPE cartridge (200 mg sorbent, 6 mL volume, Waters Corp., UK) by gravity.

steps.title: Dry SPE cartridge
steps.instruction: Dry the SPE cartridge under gentle back pressure, then place it in a centrifuge and spin at 3000 rpm for 15 min (Eppendorf centrifuge 5810, Germany) to remove residual water.

steps.title: Elute analytes with DCM
steps.instruction: Elute the retained analytes from the cartridge with two successive 5 mL portions of dichloromethane (DCM).

steps.title: Dry organic eluate
steps.instruction: Add anhydrous sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄) to the combined DCM eluate to dry remaining moisture, then transfer the clear organic phase to evaporation tubes.

steps.title: Reduce volume under nitrogen
steps.instruction: Evaporate the DCM in the tubes under a gentle stream of nitrogen using an N‑EVAP nitrogen evaporator (Organomation Associates, MA, US) until the volume reaches 200 µL.

steps.title: Remove residual DCM with toluene
steps.instruction: Add approximately 1 mL of toluene to each tube and evaporate to 200 µL; repeat this toluene addition and evaporation once more to ensure complete removal of DCM.

steps.title: Transfer extract to vial
steps.instruction: Transfer the final toluene extract to a clean vial; rinse the evaporation tube with 200 µL of toluene and add this rinse to the same vial.

steps.title: Adjust final extract volume
steps.instruction: Adjust the total extract volume in the vial to exactly 200 µL with toluene.

steps.title: Inject into GC‑MS
steps.instruction: Inject 1 µL of the final extract into the GC‑MS system for analysis.
